from fastmcp import Server
import asyncio

server = Server("message-template-server")

@server.tool()
def summarize(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Returns a user message template asking to summarize the provided text.
    
    Args:
        text: The text to be summarized
        
    Returns:
        A formatted user message asking the model to summarize the text
    """
    return f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(server.run_stdio())
